Independently verify receipt integrity and repository policy

Usage: commit-ci-preflight verify [OPTIONS] --expected-commit <EXPECTED_COMMIT>

Options:
      --receipt <RECEIPT>
          Canonical receipt JSON to verify [default: .ccp/receipt.json]
      --policy <POLICY>
          Strict repository verification policy [default: .commit-ci-policy.toml]
      --expected-commit <EXPECTED_COMMIT>
          Exact lowercase Git SHA supplied by the calling trust boundary
      --evaluated-at-utc <EVALUATED_AT_UTC>
          Explicit strict UTC evaluation instant; defaults to the local system clock
      --json
          Emit the canonical machine-readable verification report
  -h, --help
          Print help
